## Rust hooks

- Add `cargo-clippy` to lint every workspace package and target, including tests and examples. Compiler and Clippy warnings fail the hook; cognitive-complexity and nesting checks are enabled.
- Add `cargo-fmt` to format every workspace package with rustfmt.
- Include both hooks and `clippy.toml` in the copyable setup. The example config caps cognitive complexity at 15 and nesting at 3; copy it when upgrading.
- Rust hooks use the consuming repository's selected toolchain. Install its Clippy and rustfmt components before running them. A root `Cargo.toml` is required.
